item.text: The design uses warm ivory, soft blue water, and a coral accent. I’m adding a live progress meter, quick glass sizes, drink history, and a saved daily goal so the screen works as well as it looks.

item.text: The main screen is built, including custom amounts, undo, goal editing, and saved drink history. I’m checking the phone layout and logging behavior now.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('index.html')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(\"if("'!state||typeof state!=='"'object'||"'!state.days||!Number.isFinite(state.goal)||state.goal<250){state=", "const firstVisit=!state||typeof state!=='"'object'||"'!state.days||!Number.isFinite(state.goal)||state.goal<250;if(firstVisit){state=")
old="if(!state.days[today]){const seed=(h,m,amount,i)=>{let d=new Date();d.setHours(h,m,0,0);return{id:`sample-${i}`,amount,time:d.toISOString()}};state.days[today]=[seed(8,0,250,1),seed(9,30,500,2),seed(11,0,250,3),seed(12,30,250,4)].filter(l=>new Date(l.time)<=new Date());if(state.days[today].length===0)state.days[today]=[]}"
new="if(!state.days[today]){const seed=(minutesAgo,amount,i)=>{const midnight=new Date();midnight.setHours(0,0,0,0);const time=new Date(Math.max(midnight.getTime(),Date.now()-minutesAgo*60000));return{id:`sample-${i}`,amount,time:time.toISOString()}};state.days[today]=firstVisit?[seed(180,250,1),seed(110,500,2),seed(55,250,3),seed(15,250,4)]:[]}"
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("padding:30px 25px 108px", "padding:24px 25px 100px")
s=s.replace(".intro{margin:28px 0 21px}",".intro{margin:22px 0 20px}")
s=s.replace("h1{font-size:36px", "h1{font-size:34px")
s=s.replace("padding:18px 20px 16px", "padding:16px 20px 14px")
s=s.replace(".gauge{width:242px;height:242px", ".gauge{width:222px;height:222px")
s=s.replace("top:57px;width:100%", "top:51px;width:100%")
s=s.replace(".number{font-size:43px", ".number{font-size:40px")
s=s.replace("top:172px;width:100%", "top:157px;width:100%")
s=s.replace("height:70px;display:flex", "height:64px;display:flex")
s=s.replace("height:49px;font-size:12px", "height:47px;font-size:12px")
p.write_text(s)
Path('"'/tmp/drip-script.js').write_text(s.split('<script>')[1].split('</script>')[0])
PY
node --check /tmp/drip-script.js
find /opt /usr/lib /usr/bin -maxdepth 4 -iname '*playwright*' -o -iname '*chromium*' -o -iname '*puppeteer*' 2>/dev/null | head -20"
